history.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Create passenger-front-walk.png, a production animation strip for an isometric railway game. Reference image 1 is the EXACT character and painted style authority: preserve this adult man, warm skin, brown hair, forest green flat cap and waistcoat, ivory rolled-sleeve collared shirt, charcoal trousers, brown boots and small brown leather cross-body satchel on his left hip. References 2 and 3 are supporting game scale and palette only; do NOT reproduce their scenery or text. Output a real RGBA PNG with transparent alpha-zero empty background, canvas EXACTLY 1536x1024, four equal columns 384 pixels wide. Exactly one full-body figure in each column, same adult realistic proportions (7 to 7.5 heads tall), same character and outfit and same size. Figure height about 720px, cap top about y240, all feet at baseline y960. Ground anchor under body centre: (192,960), (576,960), (960,960), (1344,960). Orthographic 2:1 isometric game camera, 30 degrees down. FRONT view: walking toward lower right along tile +x, showing face and FRONT-RIGHT side in three-quarter view. Visible top of cap and shoulders, never profile or straight front. Four successive phases of IN-PLACE walking, from left to right: RIGHT foot forward and left arm forward; first passing phase with opposite leg lifted; LEFT foot forward and right arm forward; second passing phase with the other leg lifted. Keep hips centred on each anchor, identical torso facing, small natural arm swings, foot travel follows down-right/up-left diagonal. Distinct alternating walk phases; head bob at most 14px, no travel across canvas. Smooth painted contours, broad colour clusters, 3 or 4 shades per material, selective dark lower and side rims, one upper-left light. Subdued forest #294638, moss #78804C, oat #E4D5B5, limestone #BCA98B, slate #626B6C, teal #477B82, copper #A36B42, warm natural skin and hair. At 9px character height must read as clear cap/head/body/two legs/satchel silhouette: simplify tiny detail. Opaque painted figures, antialiasing only at edges. Absolutely NO ground, floor, cast shadow, ground shadow, text, labels, borders, dividers, frame numbers, glow, extra objects or extra figures. Empty space below y960. Do not draw checkerboard: real transparency.
